concepts.label: vBucket
concepts.reused_or_minted: reused - already promoted; subject of every seqno stat this command reports

relations.subject: server:vbucket
relations.evidence: This command provides details connected to the sequence number (seqno) for the specified vBucket, or for each vBucket if none is specified.

notable_absence.finding: This page and cbstats-vbucket-details.md both independently define a high_seqno stat and a purge_seqno stat ('The last seqno assigned by this vBucket.' / 'The last seqno purged by the compactor.' - identical wording on both pages), but neither page cross-references the other. The same two stat names are documented twice, with no seeAlso link tying the two reference pages together, even though vbucket-details' own table 1 repeats both fields verbatim.

cross_component_finding: high_seqno's own one-line definition on this page already forks by vBucket type within a single field: 'The last seqno assigned by this vBucket, or in case of replica, the last closed checkpoint's end seqno.' The active/replica distinction that vbucket:active-vbucket and vbucket:replica-vbucket exist to capture recurs here as a behavioral branch inside one stat's description, not just as a vBucket-type label.
cross_product_finding: No Capella analog: per-vBucket sequence-number introspection is Server-CLI-only.
